data: Which answer type has the lowest informative score at 512k oracle requests?

The question asks which answer type has the lowest informative score at 512k oracle requests. From the caption, we know that the bottom graph shows normalized informative scores per answer type, averaged over 10k questions. The x-axis represents Oracle requests (Budget $), and the y-axis represents Inform. score h.

Looking at the bottom graph, we can see that the answer types are represented by different colored lines. At 512k oracle requests, the line representing 'yes/no' is positioned at the lowest point on the y-axis among all the answer types. This indicates that 'yes/no' has the lowest informative score at this point.

Therefore, the answer type with the lowest informative score at 512k oracle requests is 'yes/no'.
